links.outcome: Comprehensibility of official consent forms rated by lay volunteers versus LLM-generated forms
links.effect: Official forms had lowest comprehensibility (3.18 ± 0.51) versus Gemini forms (4.33 ± 0.42; p < 0.001); Ateşman readability score correlated with comprehensibility (r = 0.81).
links.quote: Gemini forms achieved the highest comprehensibility (4.33 ± 0.42 vs 3.18 ± 0.51 for official forms; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Expert-rated medical quality of LLM-generated consent forms versus official forms
links.effect: Official forms scored highest for expert-rated quality (4.62 ± 0.35) versus ChatGPT-5.2 (3.85 ± 0.48) and Gemini 3 Pro (3.99 ± 0.44; p < 0.001).
links.quote: Official forms showed the highest expert-rated quality (4.62 ± 0.35) versus ChatGPT5.2 (3.85 ± 0.48) and Gemini 3 Pro (3.99 ± 0.44; p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Hybrid AI-plus-expert workflow for drafting informed consent documents

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM generation of patient informed consent forms compared to standard forms using blinded expert clinician and layperson raters, assessing readability and medical quality without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
